BiblicalUsage: Karkas is a eunuch of Xerxes, one of the seven chamberlains who served in the king's presence. When the heart of the king was merry with wine, he commanded his chamberlains to bring Queen Vashti before him — and the refusal that followed set the whole story of Esther in motion.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Karkas shows how small a hinge a great story can turn on: a chamberlain's errand, a queen's refusal, and the way opened for Esther to save her people.
